# Montenegro

[global-law](../) / Montenegro

## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 33% | 73% | not applicable | 2% |

The Constitution is held with its full in-force history, including the 2026 Amendments XVII-XXI, and checks out word for word. But of the six main codes only the Labour Act (2019) and the Administrative Procedure Act (2014) are on main, both as first published with later amendments not applied; the Criminal Code, Criminal Procedure Code and Obligations Act are held back, and the Civil Procedure Act's base text is absent. No court decisions beyond about 21 gazette items.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
